title: W-ISA: Transactional Execution of Weight-Space Intervention Programs
abstract: arXiv:2611.13232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present W-ISA, a software instruction set and transactional runtime for executing weight-space intervention programs on pretrained language models. Shape-checked instructions express parameter updates, projections, ablations, and rank-one transformations. The runtime applies these programs within request-scoped execution contexts and restores saved parameters after completion or interruption. Activation-based match-action rules connect measured model states to intervention selection. We evaluate restoration and replay on SmolLM-135M-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, and compare materialized rank-one updates with equivalent PyTorch hooks on the latter. In 45 timed requests, both intervention implementations produce identical greedy sequences at 32, 128, and 512 tokens; their maximum prompt-logit difference is 0.000184. translated_title: W-ISA：权重空间干预程序的事务化执行
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 W-ISA，这是一个用于在预训练语言模型上执行权重空间干预程序的软件指令集和事务化运行时。经过形状检查的指令可表达参数更新、投影、消融以及秩一变换。该运行时在请求作用域的执行上下文中应用这些程序，并在完成或中断后恢复已保存的参数。基于激活的匹配-动作规则将测量到的模型状态与干预选择相连接。我们在 SmolLM-135M-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上评估了参数恢复与重放功能，并在后者上将物化的秩一更新与等效的 PyTorch 钩子实现进行了比较。在 45 次定时请求中，两种干预实现在 32、128 和 512 个 token 长度下均产生完全相同的贪心解码序列；其最大提示 logits 差异仅为 0.000184。在完整的 WikiText-2 原始测试集上，SmolLM 的注意力头消融与 MLP 投影的组合变更（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 W-ISA——一套用于在预训练语言模型上事务化执行权重空间干预程序（参数更新、消融、秩一变换等）的软件指令集与运行时，可在请求结束后自动恢复模型参数，其效果与等效的 PyTorch 钩子实现完全一致。
en_tdlr: This paper presents W-ISA, a software instruction set and transactional runtime for executing weight-space intervention programs on pretrained language models with automatic parameter restoration after completion or interruption, producing outputs identical to equivalent PyTorch hook implementations.
